contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]ANT[--] ; R/ VICTORI[AE DD AVGGQ NN]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful head rosette diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]ANT[--]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding up wreaths, indistinct symbol between them. Reverse inscription: VICTORI[AE DD AVGGQ NN]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.…
